cohort: 98 patients who underwent SS or MS robotic myomectomy using the da Vinci® Si system after undergoing MRI
finding: Preoperative MRI findings can be used to select the optimal surgical technique (single-site vs multi-site robotic myomectomy) for patients who wish to conserve fertility.
mod_finding: Of the 12 patients who conceived successfully after surgery, 10 underwent an uneventful cesarean section.
